summary.name: OnionShare
summary.one_liner: OnionShare is an open-source tool for sharing files, hosting websites, and chatting anonymously over the Tor network.
use_cases: Host a temporary website as an onion site
Chat privately with friends over Tor
Share files privately on mobile devices
summary.what_it_does: OnionShare lets users share files, host websites, and chat with others using the Tor network, aiming for secure and anonymous sharing. It is open source. The page describes desktop apps for Windows, Mac, and Linux, and mobile apps developed with Guardian Project and The Calyx Institute. It can also quickly host an onion site and create a private dropbox in addition to file sharing. The page says it comes preinstalled in operating systems such as QubesOS, Tails, and ParrotOS.
notable: Uses the Tor network to share files and host sites anonymously
Mobile apps developed with Guardian Project and The Calyx Institute
Preinstalled in Qubes OS, Tails, and ParrotOS
Can host an onion site and chat in addition to file sharing
caveats: The page does not state pricing details beyond calling it open source
Mobile apps are mentioned but the page does not detail their feature set
